summary: Fervo Energy filed an 8-K to disclose a Power Purchase Agreement between its subsidiary Cape Generating Station 6 LLC and Google Energy LLC for a 396 MW enhanced geothermal project in Utah, delivered in four 99 MW tranches with commercial operation starting Q3 2028. The PPA has a 15-year term, with parent guarantees from both parties. Google gets a capacity expansion option of ~600 MW, potentially totaling ~950 MW, with a guaranteed COD by June 2030. Regulatory approvals under Utah SB 132 are pending. This is a routine commercial contract, not a special situation.
